# 🧩 Project Templates

Use these templates to make changes reviewable and repeatable.

| Template | Purpose |
|---|---|
| [Architecture Decision Record](adr.md) | Record significant technical choices |
| [Test Plan](test-plan.md) | Define verification before implementation |
| [Incident Report](incident-report.md) | Capture operational/security incidents |
| [Dataset Register](dataset-register.md) | Record source, rights, and lineage |
| [Model Build Record](model-build.md) | Record artifact reproducibility |
| [Release Checklist](release-checklist.md) | Gate a deployment |
| [Security Finding](security-finding.md) | Capture private security reports |

Copy the template and replace every prompt. Do not leave fabricated example metrics, sources, dates, or approval claims in committed records.
